Registered Nurse - Medical/Surgical Unit (Nights)
Canyon View Hospital

Canyon View Hospital is a 300-bed community hospital and part of a regional health system serving families across northern Utah.

What you will do:
- Provide safe, compassionate patient care for 4 to 5 patients per shift.
- Administer medications, monitor vital signs and update care plans in the Epic EHR.
- Collaborate with physicians, therapists and families to coordinate care.
- Follow infection control, HIPAA and patient safety policies.

Requirements:
- Current RN license in Utah or a compact state; BLS required, ACLS within 6 months.
- New graduates welcome; 12-hour night shifts and every third weekend.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to stay calm under pressure.

Canyon View Hospital is an equal opportunity employer.
